```{r}
#21
?TenMileRace
plot(time~age, data=TenMileRace, col=sex)
lines.lm <- lm(time ~ age + sex, data=TenMileRace)
summary(lines.lm)
b <- coef(lines.lm)
ggplot(TenMileRace, aes(x=age, y=time, color=sex)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=F, formula=y~x) +
  stat_function(fun = function(x) b[1] + b[2]*x) +
  stat_function(fun = function (x) (b[1] + b[3]) + b[2]*x)
```

```{r}
#25
mt.lm <- lm(mpg~hp, data=mtcars)
summary(mt.lm)
ggplot(mt.lm, aes(x=hp, y=mpg)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=F, formula=y~x)
plot(mt.lm, which=1)
boxCox(mt.lm) #lambda = 0 or log
mt.lm.log <- lm(log(mpg)~hp, data=mtcars)
summary(mt.lm.log)
b <- coef(mt.lm.log)
ggplot(mt.lm, aes(x=hp, y=mpg)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=F, formula=y~x)+
  stat_function(fun=function(x) exp(b[1] + b[2]*x))
plot(mt.lm, which=1)
predict(mt.lm.log, data.frame(hp=350))
exp(2.26041) # convert it back
```
